In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''cantina''' in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] was where [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] chased a [[Unidentified lightsaber thief|thief]] into and cornered him there. The believed he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as the thief had cut off the hand of an officer with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and they called for backup. [[Squad 40]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] arrived and stormed the cantina, killing the thief.
